run_metadata.coverage_summary: Partially degraded run. The outbound network-egress policy again blocked ALL direct page opens: every WebFetch to a tender host (tenders.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au, vendorpanel.com.au, and others tested) returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, so no live detail page or tender document could be opened, and no document-level deliverables extraction was possible. However, unlike a fully-blocked run, WebSearch (Anthropic search infrastructure) was available and returned canonical buyer-portal URLs together with indexed page titles and snippets that carry verifiable identity fields (real ATM/tender IDs embedded in the indexed page titles, agency, category, publish/close dates and short descriptions). Where the search index supplied a stable tender ID + the canonical buyer-owned detail URL + a close date, the opportunity was captured at headline/summary level from the search index, and each such field's provenance is the search-index snippet (recorded in detail_source), NOT a live page read. Fidelity checks were applied: three items still labelled 'Current ATM View' in the index were found on targeted lookup to have close dates already passed (ATM_2026_6026 solar-panel-recycling closed 24-Apr-2026; ATM_2026_6551 renewable-energy-data-platform closed 08-Jun-2026; OPC-2026-03 print-on-demand closed 29-Jul-2026) and were therefore EXCLUDED as not-open rather than recorded. Coverage: Tier 1 AusTender (well, several verified-open Commonwealth ATMs) and NSW buy.nsw (one verified-open TfNSW RFP); Tier 1 NT QTOL (one current quotation, headline only). Tier 1 VIC/QLD/WA/SA/TAS/ACT were searched but no opportunity could be verified to current-and-open standard this run (search returned portal landing pages or items of uncertain currency). Tier 2 VendorPanel and water/utility/university portals were searched (portals confirmed, no new open opportunity verified). Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue) checked as mandated: all corporate RFx are login-gated and no publicly-visible Australian corporate opportunity could be confirmed; the portals are recorded in discovered_sources, none fabricated. Source discovery surfaced two portals not in the known set (Busselton Water, DevelopmentWA) via the Tenders WA sibling-search.
gaps: OUTBOUND EGRESS BLOCKED for direct page opens: every WebFetch to a tender host returned EGRESS_BLOCKED (confirmed on www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, and a Show/GUID detail URL). No live tender detail page or attached tender document could be opened this run, so all captured detail was read from the WebSearch index (page titles + snippets), not from the live notice or its documents. Deliverables/requirements are therefore snippet-level; document-level extraction is deferred to a future run with unrestricted egress.

Three items still indexed as 'Current ATM View' had close dates already past and were excluded, not recorded: ATM_2026_6026 (National Solar Panel Recycling Pilot administrator, DCCEEW, closed 24-Apr-2026); ATM_2026_6551 (Renewable Energy Data Platform subscription, closed 08-Jun-2026); OPC-2026-03 (Office of Parliamentary Counsel print-on-demand, closed 29-Jul-2026).

Additional current AusTender ATMs were observed in the index but left unverified for currency/detail this run (no live open/verify possible): AACAP 2026-P04, ATM_2026_6066, PSC002628-01, PSC002897, LC4 IST SUMMIT 2026, RFT 04-2026, PR10031930-RASS, ATM_2026_3088, ATM_2026_5994, ASD-COM-2026-30, ATM_2026_6551(excluded). Deferred to a future run.

Tier 1 VIC (tenders.vic.gov.au / Buying for Victoria), QLD (QTenders / supply.qld.gov.au), WA (Tenders WA), SA (tenders.sa.gov.au — deep IDs 308559/315391/257497 seen but currency of the referenced items, e.g. an STV sewage-treatment spec dated 17-Mar-2026, could not be confirmed as still-open), TAS (tenders.tas.gov.au — index reported '6 new in last 7 days' but no specific verifiable IDs surfaced), and ACT (tenders.act.gov.au) searched but no opportunity met the current-and-open + verifiable-ID bar this run.
Tier 2: VendorPanel public tenders, Sydney/Melbourne Water, universities searched; portals confirmed active but no new open opportunity verified to capture standard this run.

Tier 3 (mandatory): SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP Find Opportunities / Interested Supplier Register, Rio Tinto (Ariba/SBN), Fortescue searched. All are login-gated (registration-required or invitation-only) and egress-blocked to open; no publicly-visible corporate RFx could be confirmed. Recorded as portals in discovered_sources; none fabricated as tenders.
Note (not a tender): mining majors (BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue) issue sourcing events by direct Ariba/SBN invitation to registered suppliers — invitation-only, out of scope by the routine's rules.

tenders.title: Greenhouse and Energy Minimum Standards (GEMS) Check Testing Services

tenders.description: DCCEEW is seeking accredited testing laboratories to undertake verification (check) testing of products regulated under the Greenhouse and Energy Minimum Standards Act 2012 (GEMS).

requirements: Appropriate testing-laboratory accreditation for the relevant product standards

tenders.title: Future Automated Enforcement System (FAES)
